parts.text: State five conditions for business transactions in Islam.

parts.text: Explain how trade in Islam is based upon principles from the Qurʾan.

parts.text:
‘Muslim traders should keep faith and business separate.’ Do you agree? Discuss this
statement with reference to different points of view.
